heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋一列圖片卡片（小標籤壓在圖片下緣）＋置中按鈕
desc: 上方置中的標題組，下方一列等寬等高的卡片：橫式圖片貼齊卡片上緣、小標籤壓在圖片下緣，網格下方置中一顆按鈕；手機改為圖左文右的橫向卡片直向堆疊。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，對齊頁面內容寬度，數欄，每列數量依內容而定；項目等寬，同一列等高。每個項目是一張卡片：橫式圖片在上，貼齊卡片上緣與左右兩側，所有圖片同一比例；下方的文字區靠左，放標題（可多行），標題下方可放次要文字，沒有時省略。每張卡片有一個小標籤，靠左壓在圖片下緣，跨在圖片與文字區的交界上。網格下方置中放一顆按鈕，寬度明顯大於按鈕文字但不橫跨。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，每列卡片數量減少。
mobile: 標題組維持在上方置中。網格改為直向堆疊，每列一張卡片，橫跨內容寬度；卡片內改為左右並排：左側是較小的橫式圖片，約佔卡片三成寬，不再貼齊卡片邊緣，右側放標題，標題下方的次要文字與小標籤並排在同一列（小標籤保留，但不再壓在圖片上）。按鈕保留，移到區塊最下方，橫跨內容寬度。

en.name: Centered heading + one row of image cards (label overlapping the image's bottom edge) + centered button
en.desc: A centered heading group at the top, followed by a row of equal-width, equal-height cards: a landscape image flush with the card's top edge and a label overlapping the image's bottom edge, with a centered button below the grid; on mobile the cards become horizontal image-left rows stacked vertically.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a description below; omit it when there is no content. Below the heading group is a grid of multiple items, aligned to the page content width, in several columns with the number per row depending on the content; the items are equal width, and items in the same row are equal height. Each item is a card: a landscape image on top, flush with the card's top edge and both sides, with all images in the same proportion; below it is a left-aligned text area with a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with secondary text below the title; omit it when there is no content. Each card has a label, aligned left and overlapping the bottom edge of the image, straddling the boundary between the image and the text area. Below the grid, centered, place a button that is noticeably wider than its text but not spanning.
en.tablet: Tablet uses the desktop layout, with fewer cards per row.
en.mobile: The heading group stays at the top, centered. The grid becomes a vertical stack with one card per row, spanning the content width; inside each card the parts sit side by side: a smaller landscape image on the left, about three tenths of the card width and no longer flush with the card's edges, and the title on the right, with the secondary text and the label side by side in one row below the title; the label is kept but no longer overlaps the image. The button is kept, moves to the very bottom of the section and spans the content width.
